description: This file contains actions and routing logic for handling different types of channel identifiers in a Mattermost web application, including navigation to channels by ID, name, or user identifiers, and handling errors.

methods.name: onChannelByIdentifierEnter
methods.description: Main function to handle navigation based on channel identifier type, dispatching to specific handlers.

methods.name: getPathFromIdentifier
methods.description: Determines the type of channel identifier (ID, name, user email, username, etc.) based on the input and context.

methods.name: goToChannelByChannelId
methods.description: Navigates to a channel using its ID, joining if necessary, and handling different channel types.

methods.name: goToChannelByChannelName
methods.description: Navigates to a channel by name, joining if necessary, and handling private channels.

methods.name: goToDirectChannelByUsername
methods.description: Opens a direct message channel with a user identified by username.

methods.name: goToDirectChannelByUserId
methods.description: Navigates to a direct message channel with a user by user ID.

methods.name: goToDirectChannelByUserIds
methods.description: Navigates to a direct message channel using a user ID extracted from a channel identifier.

methods.name: goToDirectChannelByEmail
methods.description: Navigates to a direct message channel with a user identified by email.

methods.name: goToGroupChannelByGroupId
methods.description: Navigates to a group channel by group ID, joining if necessary.

methods.name: doChannelChange
methods.description: Emits a channel click event for UI updates.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Redirects to a default channel in case of errors.

methods.name: isDirectChannelIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if an identifier matches the pattern for a direct channel user ID pair.

methods.name: handleChannelJoinError
methods.description: Handles errors during channel join attempts by redirecting to an error page.
